description: The Global Hydropower Tracker from Global Energy Monitor (GEM), a non-profit research organisation, is a worldwide data set of conventional hydropower and pumped storage facilities. On 26 September 2026 the page counted more than 7,000 projects in 150 countries and areas, with 1,278 GW operating and 1,116 GW prospective, including about 200 GW of operating and 700 GW of prospective pumped storage. Records give status, technology type, location, number of turbines, capacity, owner and operator, with status changes tracked from announcement to retirement. The latest release was March 2026. Coverage is global. Access is through a free online tracker map, dashboards and summary tables, and the full data set is a spreadsheet downloadable through a short download form on GEM's site, under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: status and dates of prospective projects change between releases. Simulation uses are drought and flood exposure of hydropower, storage planning for high renewable systems and climate impact studies of generation. Related records: data-gem-global-integrated-power-tracker combines GEM's power trackers and data-gem-global-energy-ownership-tracker maps owners.
